title: Acquisition & Voluntary Contribution Policy
introduction: Each eligible project in the THEARCHITECT_MAX portfolio may provide two completely separate routes: Acquire the Complete Project — As Is; and Make a Voluntary Bitcoin Contribution.
These routes are independent. A voluntary contribution does not purchase, reserve or create rights in a project. An acquisition is not a donation or voluntary contribution.

acquisition.title: Available for Acquisition
paragraphs: Where a project is marked Available for Acquisition, the complete defined project asset may be acquired AS IS.
The acquisition concerns the project in its actual documented state and agreed transfer scope at the transaction date.
The project is not represented as automatically:
bullets: complete against every original or future objective;
free from third-party dependencies or obligations;

acquisition.title: Existing Asset, Defined Scope
paragraphs: The buyer is acquiring the defined existing asset, not a promise that every possible development objective will subsequently be completed.

acquisition.title: AS IS Principle
paragraphs: AS IS means that the buyer evaluates and acquires the project based on its existing:

acquisition.title: Included and Excluded Materials
paragraphs: Only materials and rights expressly included in the definitive transaction are transferred.
Third-party software, libraries, models, datasets, APIs, standards, media, infrastructure services and other external material remain subject to their respective rights, licences and terms.

acquisition.title: Published Asking Reference
paragraphs: Where shown, the published amount is a seller-side asking reference for acquisition discussions. It is not:
bullets: evidence of a completed comparable transaction.

acquisition.title: Final Price
paragraphs: The final purchase price and transfer perimeter are determined by the definitive agreement between seller and buyer.

acquisition.title: Due Diligence
paragraphs: Before completing an acquisition, the prospective buyer is expected to evaluate the project and the proposed transfer scope.
Additional controlled information may be made available where appropriate for legitimate acquisition due diligence.
The buyer remains responsible for determining whether the project is suitable for the buyer’s intended use.

acquisition.title: Definitive Agreement
paragraphs: A project is transferred only under a definitive written agreement defining, as applicable:
bullets: applicable law and other transaction terms.

acquisition.title: No Transfer Through Publication
paragraphs: Information published on the portfolio website does not itself transfer ownership or intellectual-property rights.

acquisition.title: GitHub Pages Transaction Boundary
paragraphs: The public GitHub Pages website functions as an informational project and IP portfolio.
No purchase, payment, investment or transfer of intellectual property is completed through GitHub Pages itself.
GitHub Pages does not operate the contractual transfer process, user accounts, transaction database, escrow, billing or payment settlement for acquisition transactions.
A prospective buyer may use the website to identify the project and initiate acquisition discussions. The definitive commercial transaction is completed separately from GitHub Pages.

contribution.title: Independent Voluntary Support
paragraphs: Independent development may also be supported through a voluntary Bitcoin contribution.

contribution.title: Important
paragraphs: Send BTC only via the Bitcoin network.
Do not send another digital asset. Do not use another blockchain or network.
Assets sent using an unsupported asset or network may be permanently lost and may not be recoverable.
Always independently verify the complete receiving address before sending Bitcoin. Bitcoin transactions are generally irreversible.

contribution.title: Nature of the Contribution
paragraphs: A Bitcoin contribution is completely voluntary. It is not consideration for acquisition of a project.
A voluntary contribution does not:
bullets: purchase any part of a project;
grant a software licence unless separately agreed;
create a right to future income;
create a right to financial return;
create an entitlement to future software;
create an entitlement to a future release;
create an entitlement to development work;
create an entitlement to technical support;
create an entitlement to a commercial product.

contribution.title: No Financial Return
paragraphs: No financial return is promised or offered.

contribution.title: No Development Obligation
paragraphs: A voluntary contribution does not obligate THEARCHITECT_MAX to:

contribution.title: Existing Rights Holder
paragraphs: The project remains under the control of its existing rights holder unless and until a separate acquisition or other written agreement provides otherwise.

contribution.title: Project Reference
paragraphs: Where a contributor intends a contribution to express support for a particular project, the relevant project identifier may be referenced, for example: TA-IP-022 — Distributed AI Resource Fabric.
Such a reference is administrative only. It does not create ownership, control, contractual development rights or any other economic interest in that project.

contribution.title: Tax and Regulatory Responsibility
paragraphs: Contributors remain responsible for their own tax, accounting, regulatory and reporting obligations. The recipient remains responsible for applicable obligations relating to received contributions.
A voluntary contribution should not be interpreted as an investment or commercial purchase merely because a project also has a separately published acquisition price.

separation.title: Acquisition
paragraphs: Purpose: acquire the defined project asset.
Consideration: agreed purchase price.
Result: rights and materials defined by the definitive transfer agreement.

separation.title: Voluntary Contribution
paragraphs: Purpose: voluntarily support independent work.
Consideration: none.
Result: no ownership, repayment, financial return, IP rights or contractual development entitlement.

portfolioNotice: THEARCHITECT_MAX maintains independently scoped technology and intellectual-property assets. Projects may be available for complete acquisition in their existing documented state. The portfolio may also accept voluntary Bitcoin contributions.
Acquisition and voluntary contribution are legally and economically separate concepts. A contribution never acquires a project. An acquisition requires a separate definitive agreement.

The public website is an informational portfolio, project showroom and evidence surface. It is not an investment platform, securities platform, cryptocurrency exchange, wallet custodian, crowdfunding intermediary, escrow service or GitHub-hosted payment processor.

githubBoundary.interpretation: Informational project showcase with optional voluntary contribution information. GitHub permits some monetization such as donation buttons and crowdfunding links; this does not constitute advance approval of this specific site.
